vacancy.title: Test Facility & Instrumentation Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC test-facility engineering role. Facility upgrades, technical procurement, installation, factory acceptance testing and support to test campaigns including TVAC align strongly with industrial machine development, technical supplier coordination and commissioning. MSc and approximately four years relevant engineering experience; direct space-test heritage is the main gap. Vacancy was identified in prior official SSC sweep and independently appears on SSC company jobs listings.
